+# Bareframe Component Status
+
+Track which components are ready for documentation. When you're happy with a component after testing, change its status to `completed` or `done`.
+
+**Status values:** `completed` | `done` | `in progress`
+
+---
+

+|-----------|--------|
+| accordion | completed |
+| action-list | in progress |

-class BfButton extends HTMLElement {
-	static observedAttributes = ['selected', 'disabled', 'variant', 'label', 'group'];
-
-	constructor() {
-		super();
-		this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
-		this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
-	}
-
-	connectedCallback() {
-		if (this._initialized) {
-			this._syncState();
-			return;
-		}
-		this._initialized = true;
-		const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
-		const cssUrl = new URL('./button.css', import.meta.url);
-
-		this.shadowRoot.innerHTML = '';
-
-		const link = document.createElement('link');
-		link.rel = 'stylesheet';
-		link.href = cssUrl.href;
-
-		const button = document.createElement('button');
-		button.className = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'primary';
-		button.type = 'button';
-		button.textContent = label;
-		button.append(document.createElement('slot'));
-
-		this.shadowRoot.append(link, button);
-		this._button = button;
-		button.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
-		this._syncState();
-	}
-
-	attributeChangedCallback() {
-		this._syncState();
-	}
-
-	get selected() {
-		return this.hasAttribute('selected');
-	}
-
-	set selected(value) {
-		if (value) {
-			this.setAttribute('selected', '');
-			return;
-		}
-		this.removeAttribute('selected');
-	}
-
-	_onClick() {
-		this._applyGroupSelection();
-		const label = this.getAttribute('label') || '';
-		const variant = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'primary';
-		this.dispatchEvent(
-			new CustomEvent('bf-click', {
-				bubbles: true,
-				composed: true,
-				detail: {
-					label,
-					variant,
-					selected: this.selected,
-					group: this.getAttribute('group') || '',
-					at: new Date().toISOString(),
-				},
-			}),
-		);
-	}
-
-	_groupLimit() {
-		const multiple = this.getAttribute('multiple');
-		if (multiple === null) {
-			return 1;
-		}
-		if (multiple === '') {
-			return Infinity;
-		}
-		const parsed = Number.parseInt(multiple, 10);
-		return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 1;
-	}
-
-	_applyGroupSelection() {
-		const group = this.getAttribute('group');
-		if (!group) {
-			return;
-		}
-		const peers = [...document.querySelectorAll(`bf-button[group="${CSS.escape(group)}"]`)];
-		const cap = this._groupLimit();
-
-		if (cap === 1) {
-			for (const peer of peers) {
-				peer.selected = peer === this;
-			}
-			return;
-		}
-
-		if (this.selected) {
-			this.selected = false;
-			return;
-		}
-
-		const selectedCount = peers.filter((peer) => peer.selected).length;
-		if (selectedCount >= cap) {
-			return;
-		}
-		this.selected = true;
-	}
-
-	_syncState() {
-		if (!this._button) {
-			return;
-		}
-		this._button.className = this.getAttribute('variant') || 'primary';
-		this._button.disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');
-		this._button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(this.selected));
-		this._button.classList.toggle('is-selected', this.selected);
-	}
-}
-
-customElements.define('bf-button', BfButton);

-class BfCheckbox extends HTMLElement {
-	static observedAttributes = ['checked', 'disabled', 'label', 'value'];
-
-	constructor() {
-		super();
-		this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
-		this._onInputChange = this._onInputChange.bind(this);
-	}
-
-	connectedCallback() {
-		if (this._initialized) {
-			this._syncState();
-			return;
-		}
-		this._initialized = true;
-
-		const cssUrl = new URL('./checkbox.css', import.meta.url);
-		const link = document.createElement('link');
-		link.rel = 'stylesheet';
-		link.href = cssUrl.href;
-
-		const root = document.createElement('label');
-		root.className = 'root';
-		root.setAttribute('part', 'root');
-		root.innerHTML = `
-			<input type="checkbox" part="input" />
-			<span class="box" part="box"></span>
-			<span class="text" part="text"><slot></slot></span>
-		`;
-
-		this.shadowRoot.replaceChildren(link, root);
-		this._input = this.shadowRoot.querySelector('input');
-		this._input.addEventListener('change', this._onInputChange);
-		this._syncState();
-	}
-
-	attributeChangedCallback() {
-		this._syncState();
-	}
-
-	get checked() {
-		return this.hasAttribute('checked');
-	}
-
-	set checked(value) {
-		if (value) {
-			this.setAttribute('checked', '');
-			return;
-		}
-		this.removeAttribute('checked');
-	}
-
-	get value() {
-		return this.getAttribute('value') || this.textContent?.trim() || '';
-	}
-
-	_onInputChange() {
-		const nextChecked = this._input.checked;
-		if (nextChecked && !this._canSelectMore()) {
-			this._input.checked = false;
-			return;
-		}
-		this.checked = nextChecked;
-
-		this.dispatchEvent(
-			new CustomEvent('bf-change', {
-				bubbles: true,
-				composed: true,
-				detail: {
-					group: this._effectiveGroup(),
-					value: this.value,
-					checked: this.checked,
-				},
-			}),
-		);
-	}
-
-	_effectiveGroup() {
-		return this.getAttribute('group') || '';
-	}
-
-	_groupLimit() {
-		const multiple = this.getAttribute('multiple');
-		if (multiple === null) {
-			return Infinity;
-		}
-		if (multiple === '') {
-			return Infinity;
-		}
-		const parsed = Number.parseInt(multiple, 10);
-		return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : Infinity;
-	}
-
-	_canSelectMore() {
-		const group = this._effectiveGroup();
-		if (!group) {
-			return true;
-		}
-		const cap = this._groupLimit();
-		if (cap === Infinity) {
-			return true;
-		}
-		const selected = [
-			...document.querySelectorAll(
-				`bf-checkbox[group="${CSS.escape(group)}"][checked]`,
-			),
-		];
-		return selected.length < cap || selected.includes(this);
-	}
-
-	_syncState() {
-		if (!this._input) {
-			return;
-		}
-		this._input.checked = this.checked;
-		this._input.disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');
-		this._input.value = this.value;
-		if (this.getAttribute('label')) {
-			this.setAttribute('aria-label', this.getAttribute('label'));
-		}
-	}
-}
-
-customElements.define('bf-checkbox', BfCheckbox);

-class BfToggle extends HTMLElement {
-	static observedAttributes = ['checked', 'disabled', 'label', 'switch', 'variant'];
-
-	constructor() {
-		super();
-		this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
-		this._onClick = this._onClick.bind(this);
-	}
-
-	connectedCallback() {
-		if (this._initialized) {
-			this._sync();
-			return;
-		}
-		this._initialized = true;
-
-		const cssUrl = new URL('./toggle.css', import.meta.url);
-		const link = document.createElement('link');
-		link.rel = 'stylesheet';
-		link.href = cssUrl.href;
-
-		const root = document.createElement('button');
-		root.className = 'root';
-		root.setAttribute('part', 'root');
-		root.type = 'button';
-		root.innerHTML = `
-			<span class="track" part="track"><span class="thumb" part="thumb"></span></span>
-			<span class="text" part="text"><slot></slot></span>
-		`;
-
-		this.shadowRoot.replaceChildren(link, root);
-		this._root = root;
-		this._text = root.querySelector('.text');
-		this._root.addEventListener('click', this._onClick);
-		this._sync();
-	}
-
-	attributeChangedCallback() {
-		this._sync();
-	}
-
-	get checked() {
-		return this.hasAttribute('checked');
-	}
-
-	set checked(next) {
-		if (next) {
-			this.setAttribute('checked', '');
-			return;
-		}
-		this.removeAttribute('checked');
-	}
-
-	_onClick() {
-		if (this.hasAttribute('disabled')) {
-			return;
-		}
-		this.checked = !this.checked;
-		this.dispatchEvent(
-			new CustomEvent('bf-change', {
-				bubbles: true,
-				composed: true,
-				detail: {
-					checked: this.checked,
-				},
-			}),
-		);
-	}
-
-	_variant() {
-		const variant = (this.getAttribute('variant') || '').toLowerCase();
-		if (variant === 'switch' || this.hasAttribute('switch')) {
-			return 'switch';
-		}
-		return 'toggle';
-	}
-
-	_sync() {
-		if (!this._root) {
-			return;
-		}
-		const variant = this._variant();
-		this._root.setAttribute('data-variant', variant);
-		this._root.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(this.checked));
-		this._root.setAttribute('role', 'switch');
-		this._root.setAttribute('aria-checked', String(this.checked));
-		this._root.disabled = this.hasAttribute('disabled');
-		this._root.classList.toggle('is-checked', this.checked);
-		if (this.getAttribute('label')) {
-			this._root.setAttribute('aria-label', this.getAttribute('label'));
-		}
-		this._text.hidden = variant === 'switch' && !(this.textContent || '').trim();
-	}
-}
-
-customElements.define('bf-toggle', BfToggle);

diff --git a/public/accordion/index.html b/public/accordion/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b0e354c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/accordion/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  <section class="panel">

+        <section id="api" title="API">

+

+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Action List
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-action-list</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Action List
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/anchor">anchor</a>
+    
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/autocomplete/index.html b/public/autocomplete/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2fb0df7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/autocomplete/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Autocomplete
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-autocomplete</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Autocomplete
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/anchor">anchor</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/avatar">avatar</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/bottom-navigation/index.html b/public/bottom-navigation/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..b00efae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/bottom-navigation/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Bottom Navigation
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-bottom-navigation</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Bottom Navigation
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/avatar">avatar</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/breadcrumb">breadcrumb</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..811d974
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/button/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+		
+		
+		
+		<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Button
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-button</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Button
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/breadcrumb">breadcrumb</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/calendar">calendar</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a04e734
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/canvas/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Canvas
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-canvas</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Canvas
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/calendar">calendar</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/card">card</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Carousel
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-carousel</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Carousel
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/card">card</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/chart">chart</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+        font-weight: 600;

+
+          <a href="/">

+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>

+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+

+    Demo</h2>

+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">

+      Checkbox
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/chart">chart</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/combobox">combobox</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({

+          image: {

+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+
+          <a href="/">

+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>

+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);

+

+
+<section class="panel">

+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+

+      }

+          <a href="/">

+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Countdown
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-countdown</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Countdown
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/command-palette">command-palette</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/data-grid">data-grid</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>

+      <option value="retro">retro</option>

+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>

+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;

+

+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+

+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);

+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);

+      }

+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Date Picker
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-date-picker</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Date Picker
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/data-grid">data-grid</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/date-range-picker">date-range-picker</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>

+

+
+<section class="panel">

+      <option value="system">system</option>

+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>

+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+

+    Demo</h2>

+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">

+      demo in the new layout.</p>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Dialog
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-dialog</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Dialog
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/date-range-picker">date-range-picker</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/divider">divider</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Drawer
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-drawer</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Drawer
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/divider">divider</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/dropdown">dropdown</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+++ b/public/edge/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Edge
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-edge</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Edge
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/dropdown">dropdown</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/editor">editor</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/empty-state/index.html b/public/empty-state/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3e5b010
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/empty-state/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Empty State
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-empty-state</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Empty State
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/editor">editor</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/error-summary">error-summary</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>
