diff --git a/public/fab/index.html b/public/fab/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c65a516
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/fab/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Fab
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-fab</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Fab
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/error-summary">error-summary</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/file-upload">file-upload</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Filter Bar
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-filter-bar</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Filter Bar
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/file-upload">file-upload</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/form-field">form-field</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+++ b/public/grid/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Grid
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-grid</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Grid
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/form-field">form-field</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/hero">hero</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+

+
+

+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Icon
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-icon</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Icon
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/hero">hero</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/image">image</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+
+

+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>

+        <header><style>

+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>

+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>

+<!doctype html>
+<html>

+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Key Value List
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-key-value-list</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">

+      Key Value List
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/input">input</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/link">link</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>

diff --git a/public/link/index.html b/public/link/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..107deae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/link/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Link
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-link</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Link
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/key-value-list">key-value-list</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/list">list</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/loading-indicator/index.html b/public/loading-indicator/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6f83884
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/loading-indicator/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Loading Indicator
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-loading-indicator</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Loading Indicator
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/list">list</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/map">map</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/menu/index.html b/public/menu/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..deca3cc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/menu/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Menu
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-menu</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Menu
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/map">map</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/message">message</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Metric Card
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-metric-card</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Metric Card
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/message">message</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/modal">modal</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+++ b/public/nav/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Nav
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-nav</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Nav
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/modal">modal</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/number-field">number-field</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>

+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>

+      <option value="noir">noir</option>

+

+

+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>

+<!doctype html>

+

+        display: flex;

+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }

+        font-weight: 600;

+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);

+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;

+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;

+        min-height: 120px;

+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }

+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Quick Actions
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-quick-actions</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Quick Actions
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/progress">progress</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/radio">radio</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>

+        .Donation

+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',

+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Range
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-range</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Range
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/radio">radio</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/search">search</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/segmented-control/index.html b/public/segmented-control/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1cf81b4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/segmented-control/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Segmented Control
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-segmented-control</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Segmented Control
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/search">search</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/select">select</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/skeleton/index.html b/public/skeleton/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d8e846b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/skeleton/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Skeleton
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-skeleton</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Skeleton
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/select">select</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/split-button">split-button</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>
