diff --git a/public/splitter/index.html b/public/splitter/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..5adaf08
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/splitter/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Splitter
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-splitter</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Splitter
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/split-button">split-button</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/stack">stack</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/tab/index.html b/public/tab/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a31237f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/tab/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Tab
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-tab</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Tab
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/stack">stack</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/table">table</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Tag
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-tag</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Tag
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/table">table</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/timeline">timeline</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

diff --git a/public/toast/index.html b/public/toast/index.html
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..67f062b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/toast/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Toast
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-toast</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Toast
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/timeline">timeline</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/toggle">toggle</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Toolbar
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-toolbar</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Toolbar
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/toggle">toggle</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/tree-view">tree-view</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6710b88
--- /dev/null
+++ b/public/video-player/index.html
@@ -0,0 +1,205 @@
+
+
+
+
+
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header><style>
+  .panel {
+    border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+    border-radius: 12px;
+    background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+    padding: 1rem;
+  }
+
+  .theme-controls {
+    display: flex;
+    flex-wrap: wrap;
+    align-items: center;
+    gap: 0.7rem;
+  }
+</style>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="theme-controls">
+    <label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+    <select id="themeSelect">
+      <option value="system">system</option>
+      <option value="light">light</option>
+      <option value="dark">dark</option>
+      <option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+      <option value="retro">retro</option>
+      <option value="modern">modern</option>
+      <option value="simple">simple</option>
+      <option value="nature">nature</option>
+      <option value="future">future</option>
+      <option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+      <option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+      <option value="desert">desert</option>
+      <option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+      <option value="noir">noir</option>
+      <option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+      <option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+    </select>
+    <span id="themeStatus"></span>
+  </div>
+</section></header>
+        
+  
+  
+  
+  <section class="panel">
+  <h2>Video Player
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-video-player</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      Video Player
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    
+      <a href="/tree-view">tree-view</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/accordion">accordion</a>
+    
+    
+      <a href="/virtual-list">virtual-list</a>
+    
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer></footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+	<head>
+		<meta charset="utf-8" />
+		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+		<title>bareframe accordion test</title>
+		<link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="./themes/system.css" />
+		<style>
+			body {
+				font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+				margin: 2rem;
+				line-height: 1.45;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+			}
+
+			.layout {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 1rem;
+				max-width: 980px;
+			}
+
+			.panel {
+				border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+				border-radius: 12px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+				padding: 1rem;
+			}
+
+			.theme-controls,
+			.demo-row {
+				display: flex;
+				flex-wrap: wrap;
+				align-items: center;
+				gap: 0.7rem;
+			}
+
+			.stack {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+			}
+			.label {
+				font-weight: 600;
+			}
+			.hint {
+				margin: 0;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+			}
+			.tableish {
+				display: grid;
+				grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+				gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+			}
+			.viz {
+				display: flex;
+				align-items: end;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+				min-height: 120px;
+			}
+			.viz > div {
+				width: 24px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+				border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+			}
+			code {
+				background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+				padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+				border-radius: 6px;
+			}
+		</style>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<div class="layout">
+			<header>
+				<h1>bf-accordion</h1>
+				<p>Expand/collapse grouped content panels.</p>
+				<p><a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a></p>
+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<div class="stack">
+					<div class="demo-row">
+						<bf-button bf-open="docs-accordion:intro">Open Intro</bf-button>
+						<bf-button variant="secondary" bf-toggle="docs-accordion:api"
+							>Toggle API</bf-button
+						>
+					</div>
+					<bf-accordion id="docs-accordion">
+						<section id="intro" title="Introduction">
+							<p>Reusable component composition block.</p>
+						</section>
+						<section id="api" title="API">
+							<p>Open/close sections by id for deterministic tests.</p>
+						</section>
+					</bf-accordion>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>
+				<div class="demo-row">
+					<a href="./card-test.html">card</a>
+					<a href="./edge-test.html">edge</a>
+					<a href="./nav-test.html">nav</a>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Tag</h2>
+				<code>bf-accordion</code>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+		<script type="module">
+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+	<body>

+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<div class="stack">
+					<div class="demo-row">
+						<bf-button bf-open="drawer-right">Right Drawer</bf-button>
+						<bf-button variant="secondary" bf-open="drawer-left"
+							>Left Drawer</bf-button
+						>
+						<bf-button variant="secondary" bf-open="drawer-bottom"
+							>Bottom Drawer</bf-button
+						>

+
+					<bf-drawer id="drawer-right" side="right" label="Filters">

+						<bf-button bf-close="drawer-right">Done</bf-button>
+					</bf-drawer>
+
+					<bf-drawer id="drawer-left" side="left" label="Navigation">
+						<h3 style="margin-top: 0">Navigation</h3>
+						<p>Left-side app navigation drawer.</p>
+						<bf-button bf-close="drawer-left">Close</bf-button>
+					</bf-drawer>
+
+					<bf-drawer id="drawer-bottom" side="bottom" label="Actions">
+						<h3 style="margin-top: 0">Quick Actions</h3>
+						<p>Bottom drawer for contextual actions.</p>
+						<bf-button bf-close="drawer-bottom">Close</bf-button>
+					</bf-drawer>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>

+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Tag</h2>
+				<code>bf-drawer</code>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>

+			function applyTheme(theme) {

+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>

+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>

+</html>

+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+	<head>
+		<meta charset="utf-8" />
+		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+		<title>bareframe icon test</title>
+		<link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="./themes/system.css" />
+		<style>
+			body {
+				font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+				margin: 2rem;
+				line-height: 1.45;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+			}
+
+			.layout {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 1rem;
+				max-width: 980px;
+			}
+
+			.panel {
+				border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+				border-radius: 12px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+				padding: 1rem;
+			}
+
+			.theme-controls,
+			.demo-row {
+				display: flex;
+				flex-wrap: wrap;
+				align-items: center;
+				gap: 0.7rem;
+			}
+
+			.stack {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+			}
+			.label {
+				font-weight: 600;
+			}
+			.hint {
+				margin: 0;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+			}
+			.tableish {
+				display: grid;
+				grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+				gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+			}
+			.viz {
+				display: flex;
+				align-items: end;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+				min-height: 120px;
+			}
+			.viz > div {
+				width: 24px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+				border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+			}
+			code {
+				background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+				padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+				border-radius: 6px;
+			}
+		</style>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<div class="layout">
+			<header>
+				<h1>bf-icon</h1>
+				<p>Inline icon renderer with size/color props.</p>
+				<p><a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a></p>
+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<bf-icon>
+					<h3>icon</h3>
+					<p>Reusable component composition block.</p>
+				</bf-icon>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>
+				<div class="demo-row">
+					<a href="./avatar-test.html">avatar</a>
+					<a href="./image-test.html">image</a>
+					<a href="./video-player-test.html">video-player</a>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Tag</h2>
+				<code>bf-icon</code>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+		<script type="module">
+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+		</style>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<div class="layout">
+			<header>
+				<h1>bf-skeleton</h1>
+				<p>Loading placeholder for content blocks.</p>
+				<p><a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a></p>
+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<div class="stack">
+					<p class="hint">
+						Use <code>skeleton</code> on any element/component. Add a time like
+						<code>skeleton="1400"</code> or <code>skeleton="1.4s"</code> to
+						auto-reveal.
+					</p>
+					<div class="demo-row">
+						<bf-button id="skeletonReplay" variant="secondary"
+							>Replay Loading</bf-button
+						>
+					</div>
+					<div row>
+						<div col="6">
+							<bf-card id="sk-card" skeleton="1800">
+								<div stack="sm">
+									<img
+										alt=""
+										src="https://picsum.photos/seed/bf/640/360"
+										style="width: 100%; border-radius: 12px"
+									/>
+									<div class="demo-row" style="align-items: center">
+										<bf-avatar name="Alex Rivera"></bf-avatar>
+										<div stack>
+											<strong>Async Content Card</strong>
+											<span class="hint">Loaded after 1.8s</span>
+										</div>
+									</div>
+									<p class="hint">
+										Skeleton utility overlays this entire card while waiting for
+										data.
+									</p>
+									<bf-button>Open</bf-button>
+								</div>
+							</bf-card>
+						</div>
+						<div col="6">
+							<bf-card>
+								<div stack="sm">
+									<strong>List Loading Utility</strong>
+									<div stack="sm">
+										<div
+											id="sk-row-1"
+											class="demo-row"
+											style="align-items: center"
+											skeleton="1200"
+										>
+											<bf-avatar name="Taylor"></bf-avatar>
+											<div stack style="flex: 1">
+												<strong>Taylor</strong>
+												<span class="hint">Design System</span>
+											</div>
+										</div>
+										<div
+											id="sk-row-2"
+											class="demo-row"
+											style="align-items: center"
+											skeleton="1700"
+										>
+											<bf-avatar name="Jordan"></bf-avatar>
+											<div stack style="flex: 1">
+												<strong>Jordan</strong>
+												<span class="hint">Frontend Platform</span>
+											</div>
+										</div>
+										<div
+											id="sk-row-3"
+											class="demo-row"
+											style="align-items: center"
+											skeleton="2.2s"
+										>
+											<bf-avatar name="Morgan"></bf-avatar>
+											<div stack style="flex: 1">
+												<strong>Morgan</strong>
+												<span class="hint">Infra Team</span>
+											</div>
+										</div>
+									</div>
+								</div>
+							</bf-card>
+						</div>
+					</div>
+					<script>
+						document
+							.getElementById('skeletonReplay')
+							?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+								const targets = ['sk-card', 'sk-row-1', 'sk-row-2', 'sk-row-3']
+									.map((id) => document.getElementById(id))
+									.filter(Boolean);
+								targets.forEach((node) => node.removeAttribute('skeleton'));
+								requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+									document
+										.getElementById('sk-card')
+										?.setAttribute('skeleton', '1800');
+									document
+										.getElementById('sk-row-1')
+										?.setAttribute('skeleton', '1200');
+									document
+										.getElementById('sk-row-2')
+										?.setAttribute('skeleton', '1700');
+									document
+										.getElementById('sk-row-3')
+										?.setAttribute('skeleton', '2.2s');
+								});
+							});
+					</script>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>
+				<div class="demo-row">
+					<a href="./card-test.html">card</a>
+					<a href="./edge-test.html">edge</a>
+					<a href="./nav-test.html">nav</a>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Tag</h2>
+				<code>bf-skeleton</code>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+		<script type="module">
+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+	<head>
+		<meta charset="utf-8" />
+		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+		<title>bareframe toast test</title>
+		<link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="./themes/system.css" />
+		<style>
+			body {
+				font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+				margin: 2rem;
+				line-height: 1.45;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+			}
+
+			.layout {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 1rem;
+				max-width: 980px;
+			}
+
+			.panel {
+				border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+				border-radius: 12px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+				padding: 1rem;
+			}
+
+			.theme-controls,
+			.demo-row {
+				display: flex;
+				flex-wrap: wrap;
+				align-items: center;
+				gap: 0.7rem;
+			}
+
+			.stack {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+			}
+			.label {
+				font-weight: 600;
+			}
+			.hint {
+				margin: 0;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+			}
+			.tableish {
+				display: grid;
+				grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+				gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+			}
+			.viz {
+				display: flex;
+				align-items: end;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+				min-height: 120px;
+			}
+			.viz > div {
+				width: 24px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+				border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+			}
+			code {
+				background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+				padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+				border-radius: 6px;
+			}
+		</style>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<div class="layout">
+			<header>
+				<h1>bf-toast</h1>
+				<p>
+					Unified toast/alert/notification/snackbar/banner primitive with type +
+					position utilities.
+				</p>
+				<p><a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a></p>
+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<div class="stack">
+					<bf-toast banner info open
+						>Banner notice for account-wide maintenance.</bf-toast
+					>
+					<bf-toast toast info open>Default Toast</bf-toast>
+					<bf-toast alert warning open top right
+						>Alert Toast (top-right)</bf-toast
+					>
+					<bf-toast notification success open position="bottom-left"
+						>Notification Toast (bottom-left)</bf-toast
+					>
+					<bf-toast snackbar open duration="2800"
+						>Snackbar (bottom-center default)</bf-toast
+					>
+					<bf-toast error open duration="2200" position="top-center"
+						>Auto-hide Error (2.2s)</bf-toast
+					>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>
+				<div class="demo-row">
+					<a href="./button-test.html">button</a>
+					<a href="./toast-test.html">toast</a>
+					<a href="./dialog-test.html">dialog</a>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Tag</h2>
+				<code>bf-toast</code>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+		<script type="module">
+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+<!doctype html>
+<html lang="en">
+	<head>
+		<meta charset="utf-8" />
+		<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
+		<title>bareframe utilities test</title>
+		<link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="./themes/system.css" />
+		<style>
+			body {
+				font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+				margin: 2rem;
+				line-height: 1.45;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+			}
+
+			.layout {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 1rem;
+				max-width: 980px;
+			}
+			.panel {
+				border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+				border-radius: 12px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+				padding: 1rem;
+			}
+			.theme-controls,
+			.demo-row {
+				display: flex;
+				flex-wrap: wrap;
+				align-items: center;
+				gap: 0.7rem;
+			}
+			.stack {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 0.5rem;
+			}
+			.hint {
+				margin: 0;
+				color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+			}
+			.swatch {
+				border: 1px dashed var(--bf-theme-border-1, #cbd5e1);
+				border-radius: 8px;
+				padding: 0.55rem;
+			}
+			.colbox {
+				min-height: 7.2rem;
+				border: 1px dashed var(--bf-theme-border-1, #cbd5e1);
+				border-radius: 8px;
+				padding: 0.45rem;
+			}
+			code {
+				background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+				padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+				border-radius: 6px;
+			}
+		</style>
+	</head>
+	<body>
+		<div class="layout">
+			<header>
+				<h1>Utilities</h1>
+				<p>
+					Global utility attributes that work across plain HTML and
+					<code>bf-*</code> components.
+				</p>
+				<p><a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a></p>
+			</header>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>
+						<option value="dark">dark</option>
+						<option value="sprint">sprint</option>
+						<option value="retro">retro</option>
+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel" stack="sm">
+				<h2 style="margin: 0">Row + Col</h2>
+				<p class="hint">
+					Alignment utilities: <code>row="left|center|right"</code> and
+					<code>col="top|center|bottom"</code>.
+				</p>
+				<div row="left" class="swatch">
+					<bf-button>Left 1</bf-button
+					><bf-button variant="secondary">Left 2</bf-button>
+				</div>
+				<div row="center" class="swatch">
+					<bf-button>Center 1</bf-button
+					><bf-button variant="secondary">Center 2</bf-button>
+				</div>
+				<div row="right" class="swatch">
+					<bf-button>Right 1</bf-button
+					><bf-button variant="secondary">Right 2</bf-button>
+				</div>
+
+				<div row>
+					<div col="top" class="colbox">
+						<bf-tag>Top</bf-tag><bf-button>Action</bf-button>
+					</div>
+					<div col="center" class="colbox">
+						<bf-tag>Center</bf-tag><bf-button>Action</bf-button>
+					</div>
+					<div col="bottom" class="colbox">
+						<bf-tag>Bottom</bf-tag><bf-button>Action</bf-button>
+					</div>
+				</div>
+
+				<p class="hint">
+					Grid spans still use numeric values: <code>col="3"</code> ..
+					<code>col="12"</code>.
+				</p>
+				<div row class="swatch">
+					<div col="3"><bf-card>3</bf-card></div>
+					<div col="6"><bf-card>6</bf-card></div>
+					<div col="3"><bf-card>3</bf-card></div>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel" stack="sm">
+				<h2 style="margin: 0">Stack</h2>
+				<p class="hint">
+					Spacing utility on any element: <code>stack="xs|sm|md|lg|xl"</code>.
+				</p>
+				<div stack="xs" class="swatch">
+					<bf-tag>xs</bf-tag><bf-tag>gap</bf-tag><bf-tag>stack</bf-tag>
+				</div>
+				<div stack="md" class="swatch">
+					<bf-tag>md</bf-tag><bf-tag>gap</bf-tag><bf-tag>stack</bf-tag>
+				</div>
+				<div stack="xl" class="swatch">
+					<bf-tag>xl</bf-tag><bf-tag>gap</bf-tag><bf-tag>stack</bf-tag>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel" stack="sm">
+				<h2 style="margin: 0">Typography</h2>
+				<p typography="display">Display Utility</p>
+				<p typography="h1">Heading 1 Utility</p>
+				<p typography="h2">Heading 2 Utility</p>
+				<p typography="body">Body utility text for standard copy.</p>
+				<small typography="caption">Caption utility text.</small>
+				<span typography="label">Label utility text.</span>
+				<span typography="code">const mode = 'utility'</span>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel" stack="sm">
+				<h2 style="margin: 0">Table Utilities</h2>
+				<p class="hint">
+					Use <code>table</code>, <code>thead</code>, <code>tbody</code>,
+					<code>tr</code>, <code>th</code>, and <code>td</code> directly on
+					plain elements.
+				</p>
+				<div table dense>
+					<div thead>
+						<div tr>
+							<div th>Key</div>
+							<div th>Value</div>
+							<div th>Note</div>
+						</div>
+					</div>
+					<div tbody>
+						<div tr>
+							<div td>layout</div>
+							<div td>row / col / stack</div>
+							<div td>Global utility attrs</div>
+						</div>
+						<div tr>
+							<div td>typography</div>
+							<div td>display, h1..code</div>
+							<div td>No class names required</div>
+						</div>
+						<div tr>
+							<div td>skeleton</div>
+							<div td>skeleton="1200"</div>
+							<div td>Auto-reveal supported</div>
+						</div>
+					</div>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel" stack="sm">
+				<h2 style="margin: 0">Skeleton Utility</h2>
+				<p class="hint">
+					Attach loading state directly to target elements:
+					<code>skeleton</code> or <code>skeleton="1200"</code>.
+				</p>
+				<div id="utility-skel-row" row>
+					<bf-card id="utility-skel-card" col="6" skeleton="1500">
+						<div stack="sm">
+							<strong>Utility Loading Card</strong>
+							<p class="hint">This content appears after the skeleton delay.</p>
+							<bf-button>View</bf-button>
+						</div>
+					</bf-card>
+					<div col="6" skeleton="2s" class="swatch">
+						<strong>Plain Div Skeleton</strong>
+						<p class="hint">Works on regular HTML too.</p>
+					</div>
+				</div>
+				<div row>
+					<bf-button id="utilityReplay" variant="secondary"
+						>Replay Skeleton Utility</bf-button
+					>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+		</div>
+
+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+		<script type="module">
+			const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+			const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+			const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+			function applyTheme(theme) {
+				themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+				document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+				themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+			}
+
+			themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () =>
+				applyTheme(themeSelect.value),
+			);
+			applyTheme('system');
+
+			document
+				.getElementById('utilityReplay')
+				?.addEventListener('click', () => {
+					const card = document.getElementById('utility-skel-card');
+					const row = document.getElementById('utility-skel-row');
+					const divTarget = row?.querySelector('div[col="6"]');
+					if (!card || !divTarget) return;
+					card.removeAttribute('skeleton');
+					divTarget.removeAttribute('skeleton');
+					requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+						card.setAttribute('skeleton', '1500');
+						divTarget.setAttribute('skeleton', '2s');
+					});
+				});
+		</script>
+	</body>
+</html>

+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+			}
+
+			.layout {
+				display: grid;
+				gap: 1rem;
+				max-width: 980px;
+			}
+
+			.panel {
+				border: 1px solid var(--bf-theme-border-1, #d1d5db);
+				border-radius: 12px;
+				background: var(--bf-theme-surface-1, #ffffff);
+				padding: 1rem;
+			}
+
+			.theme-controls,
+			.demo-row {
+				display: flex;
+				flex-wrap: wrap;
+				align-items: center;
+				gap: 0.7rem;

+				display: grid;

+				gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;

+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<div class="theme-controls">
+					<label for="themeSelect">Theme</label>
+					<select id="themeSelect">
+						<option value="system">system</option>
+						<option value="light">light</option>

+						<option value="modern">modern</option>
+						<option value="simple">simple</option>
+						<option value="nature">nature</option>
+						<option value="future">future</option>
+						<option value="aurora">aurora</option>
+						<option value="nebula">nebula</option>
+						<option value="desert">desert</option>
+						<option value="matrix">matrix</option>
+						<option value="noir">noir</option>
+						<option value="sunrise">sunrise</option>
+						<option value="oceanic">oceanic</option>
+					</select>
+					<span id="themeStatus"></span>
+				</div>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Primary Demo</h2>
+				<bf-video-player>
+					<h3>video player</h3>
+					<p>Reusable component composition block.</p>
+				</bf-video-player>
+			</section>
+
+			<section class="panel">
+				<h2>Related Components</h2>
+				<div class="demo-row">
+					<a href="./avatar-test.html">avatar</a>

+					<a href="./video-player-test.html">video-player</a>

+
+			<section class="panel">

+		<script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>

+

diff --git a/src/_template/component.ts b/src/_template/component.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..cfe4d4e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/_template/component.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,63 @@
+export default class BfComponent extends HTMLElement {
+	protected _initialized = false;
+	protected name = 'bf-component';
+	protected link: HTMLLinkElement | null = null;
+	protected root: HTMLElement = document.createElement('div');
+
+	constructor(name: string) {
+		super();
+		if (!this.shadowRoot) {
+			this.attachShadow({ mode: 'open' });
+		}
+		this.name = name;
+	}
+
+	ensureInitialized() {
+		if (this._initialized) {
+			return false;
+		}
+		this._initialized = true;
+		return true;
+	}
+
+	createStyleLink(
+		baseUrl = import.meta.url,
+		baseCss: string = `./${this.name}.css`,
+	): HTMLLinkElement {
+		const cssUrl = new URL(baseCss, baseUrl);
+		const link = document.createElement('link');
+		link.rel = 'stylesheet';
+		link.href = cssUrl.href;
+		return link;
+	}
+
+	mount() {
+		this.link = this.createStyleLink();
+		this.root = document.createElement('div');
+		this.root.setAttribute('part', 'root');
+		this.root.innerHTML = `<slot></slot>`;
+		if (this.shadowRoot) this.shadowRoot.replaceChildren(this.link, this.root);
+	}
+
+	connectedCallback() {
+		if (!this.ensureInitialized()) return;
+
+		this.mount();
+	}
+
+	disconnectedCallback() {
+		if (!this.ensureInitialized()) return;
+	}
+
+	connectedMoveCallback() {
+		if (!this.ensureInitialized()) return;
+	}
+
+	adoptedCallback() {
+		if (!this.ensureInitialized()) return;
+	}
+
+	attributeChangedCallback(name: string, oldValue: unknown, newValue: unknown) {
+		if (!this.ensureInitialized()) return;
+	}
+}

+	--_bf-button-hover-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bf-button-outlined-color) 12%, transparent);
+	--_bf-button-hover-color: var(--bf-button-outlined-color);
+	--_bf-button-hover-border-color: var(--bf-button-outlined-border-color);
+	--_bf-button-active-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bf-button-outlined-color) 20%, transparent);
+	--_bf-button-active-color: var(--bf-button-outlined-color);
+	--_bf-button-active-border-color: var(--bf-button-outlined-border-color);
+}
+
+button.ghost {
+	--_bf-button-bg: var(--bf-button-ghost-bg);
+	--_bf-button-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-color);
+	--_bf-button-border-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-border-color);
+	--_bf-button-hover-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bf-button-ghost-color) 12%, transparent);
+	--_bf-button-hover-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-color);
+	--_bf-button-hover-border-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-border-color);
+	--_bf-button-active-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bf-button-ghost-color) 20%, transparent);
+	--_bf-button-active-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-color);
+	--_bf-button-active-border-color: var(--bf-button-ghost-border-color);
+}
+
 button.is-selected {
 	box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--bf-theme-focus-ring-color, #93c5fd);
 }
+
+/* When used as bf-dropdown trigger with border, let the dropdown provide the border */
+:host-context(bf-dropdown[border]) button {
+	border: none;
+	background: transparent;
+}

new file mode 100644

+++ b/views/accordion/index.njk
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+{% extends 'layouts/base.njk' %}
+{% block main %}
+  <section class="panel">
+    <h2>Accordian Demo</h2>
+    <p>Tag:
+      <code>bf-accordian</code>
+    </p>
+  </section>
+  <section class="panel">
+
+    <div class="stack">
+      <div class="demo-row">
+        <bf-button bf-open="docs-accordion:intro">Open Intro</bf-button>
+        <bf-button variant="secondary" bf-toggle="docs-accordion:api">Toggle API</bf-button >
+      </div>
+      <bf-accordion id="docs-accordion">
+        <section id="intro" title="Introduction">
+          <p>Reusable component composition block.</p>
+        </section>
+        <section id="api" title="API">
+          <p>Open/close sections by id for deterministic tests.</p>
+        </section>
+      </bf-accordion>
+    </div>
+  </section>
+
+  <section class="panel">
+    <h2>Related Components</h2>
+    <div class="demo-row">
+      <a href="/card">card</a>
+      <a href="/edge">edge</a>
+      <a href="/nav">nav</a>
+    </div>
+  </section>
+{% endblock %}

diff --git a/views/layouts/base.njk b/views/layouts/base.njk
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d23b0dc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/views/layouts/base.njk
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+<!doctype html>
+<html>
+  <head>
+    <meta charset="utf-8"/>
+    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"/>
+    <link id="themeStylesheet" rel="stylesheet" href="/themes/system.css"/>
+    <title>
+      {{ title | 'Base' }}
+    </title>
+    <style>
+      body {
+        font-family: 'Avenir Next', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
+        margin: 2rem;
+        line-height: 1.45;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-1, #111827);
+        background: var(--bf-theme-surface-2, #f8fafc);
+      }
+
+      .layout {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 1rem;
+        max-width: 980px;
+      }
+
+      .layout .header {
+        display: flex;
+        justify-content: space-between;
+      }
+
+      .demo-row {
+        display: flex;
+        flex-wrap: wrap;
+        align-items: center;
+        gap: 0.7rem;
+      }
+
+      .stack {
+        display: grid;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+      }
+      .label {
+        font-weight: 600;
+      }
+      .hint {
+        margin: 0;
+        color: var(--bf-theme-text-2, #4b5563);
+      }
+      .tableish {
+        display: grid;
+        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
+        gap: 0.35rem 0.75rem;
+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  <body>
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header class="header">
+
+          <a href="/">
+            <h2>Bareframe</h2>
+          </a>
+
+          <div id="donate-button-container">
+            <div id="donate-button"></div>
+          </div>
+        </header>
+        <header>{% include "partials/theme-select.njk" %}</header>
+        {% block main %}{% endblock %}
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer>{{ footer | lower }}</footer>
+    <script type="module" src="/dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = '/themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+    <script src="https://www.paypalobjects.com/donate/sdk/donate-sdk.js" charset="UTF-8"></script>
+    <script>
+      PayPal
+        .Donation
+        .Button({
+          env: 'production',
+          hosted_button_id: 'LKTM22NDQDVW6',
+          image: {
+            src: 'https://www.paypalobjects.com/en_US/GB/i/btn/btn_donateCC_LG.gif',
+            alt: 'Donate with PayPal button',
+            title: 'PayPal - The safer, easier way to pay online!'
+          }
+        })
+        .render('#donate-button');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>

+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>{{ heading }}
+    Demo</h2>
+  <p>Tag:
+    <code>bf-{{ component }}</code>
+  </p>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <div class="stack">
+    <p class="hint">This page is ready for a dedicated
+      {{ heading }}
+      demo in the new layout.</p>
+    <p>
+      <a href="/">Back to component index</a>
+    </p>
+  </div>
+</section>
+
+<section class="panel">
+  <h2>Related Components</h2>
+  <div class="demo-row">
+    {% if relatedOne %}
+      <a href="/{{ relatedOne }}">{{ relatedOne }}</a>
+    {% endif %}
+    {% if relatedTwo %}
+      <a href="/{{ relatedTwo }}">{{ relatedTwo }}</a>
+    {% endif %}
+    {% if relatedThree %}
+      <a href="/{{ relatedThree }}">{{ relatedThree }}</a>
+    {% endif %}
+  </div>
+</section>

+      }
+      .viz {
+        display: flex;
+        align-items: end;
+        gap: 0.5rem;
+        min-height: 120px;
+      }
+      .viz > div {
+        width: 24px;
+        background: var(--bf-theme-button-primary-bg, #2563eb);
+        border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
+      }
+      code {
+        background: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.2);
+        padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
+        border-radius: 6px;
+      }
+    </style>
+  </head>
+  {% block vars %}{% endblock %}
+  <body>
+    {# <header>{% include "partials/header.njk" %}</header> #}
+
+    <main>
+      <div class="layout">
+        <header>
+          <h1>bf-{{ title or default('base') }}</h1>
+          <p>Expand/collapse grouped content panels.</p>
+          <p>
+            <a href="./index.html">Back to Examples</a>
+          </p>
+        </header>
+        <header>{% include "partials/theme-select.njk" %}</header>
+        {% block main %}{% endblock %}
+      </div>
+    </main>
+
+    <footer>{{ footer | lower }}</footer>
+    <script type="module" src="./dist/index.js"></script>
+    <script type="module">
+      const themeSelect = document.getElementById('themeSelect');
+      const themeStatus = document.getElementById('themeStatus');
+      const themeStylesheet = document.getElementById('themeStylesheet');
+
+      function applyTheme(theme) {
+        themeStylesheet.href = './themes/' + theme + '.css';
+        document
+          .documentElement
+          .setAttribute('data-bf-theme', theme);
+        themeStatus.textContent = 'Active: ' + theme;
+      }
+
+      themeSelect.addEventListener('change', () => applyTheme(themeSelect.value),);
+      applyTheme('system');
+    </script>
+  </body>
+</html>
\ No newline at end of file
